277221198.description:
Natural Float Copper
Polished Ore Specimen Bookends
Naturalistic Style, Vintage
This substantial pair of bookends is crafted from large float copper specimens, likely originating from the glacial deposits of the Lake Superior region. Each piece features a professionally cut and polished face that reveals the brilliant, lustrous metallic copper interior set within a dark mineral matrix. The high-contrast finish between the mirror-polished display surface and the rugged, natural exterior showcases the raw geological beauty of the native copper.
Natural float copper ore construction with high-gloss polished display faces
Significant weight and density provides excellent stability for supporting large volumes
Natural raw texture preserved on the reverse and sides showcasing original matrix stone
Dimensions: 6.5" Length x 5" Width x 3.5" Height
Total Weight: 19.4 lbs
Condition:
Good vintage condition. The polished faces maintain a bright metallic luster with minor surface oxidation and natural pitting consistent with geological specimens. The cut bases are flat and stable. No structural cracks or significant damage beyond natural mineral inclusions and wear to the raw textured edges.
